questions.title: 60. What are Hooks?
questions.summary:
◦ H^ = special R^ F()s that let C^s use R^ features.
◦ Enable state, effects, refs, context, and reusable logic.
questions.answer:
◦ H^ = special R^ F()s that let functional C^s use state and other R^ capabilities.
◦ State H^ → useState, useReducer.
◦ Effect H^ → useEffect, useLayoutEffect.
◦ Ref H^ → useRef, useImperativeHandle.
◦ Context H^ → useContext.
◦ Performance H^ → useMemo, useCallback.
◦ CH^ → Extract reusable stateful logic.
◦ RoH → Call H^ at top^lvl of C^s or CH^s.
◦ H^ must preserve consistent call order across renders.
questions.underTheHood:
◦ R^ associates H^ data w1 the owning C^ Fiber.
◦ Stateful H^ records are tracked in call order.
◦ During r(), R^ matches each H^ call to its previous record.
◦ useState/useReducer maintain update queues.
◦ H^ updates schedule work on the owning Fiber.
◦ Each mounted C^ instance has independent H^ state.
pitfalls: ◦ Never call H^ conditionally or inside loops.
◦ Never call H^ inside ordinary event handlers.
◦ Do not call H^ after conditional early returns.
◦ CH^ share logic, not automatically shared state.
◦ useEffect is for synchronization, not every calculation.
followUps: ◦ How does R^ associate state w1 H^?
◦ How does H^ call order relate to Fiber?
questions.recall:
◦ H^ → R^ features inside C^.
◦ Fiber → H^ records → Call order.
◦ RoH → top^lvl + consistent order.
◦ CH^ → Reusable logic.
